s: Together with a third-party vendor, we have developed a machine learning algorithm that, on a patient-by-patient basis, predicts the loci most likely to improve through evaluation of baseline visual sensitivity.

Together with a third-party vendor, we have developed a machine learning algorithm based on the available microperimetry data from Horizon and Skyline expansion trials that, on a patient-by-patient basis, predicts the loci most likely to improve through evaluation of baseline visual sensitivity.
